The '''trident of the seas''' is a one-handed [[powered staff]] requiring 75 [[Magic]] to wield. Once charged with runes and coins, it can be used to attack with a built-in magic spell regardless of the player’s current [[spellbook]].

It is available as a task-only drop from [[cave kraken]]s (or the [[kraken]] boss) with level 87 [[Slayer]]; normal cave krakens can drop an uncharged trident, whereas the kraken boss can drop a fully charged one. Similar to [[Barrows equipment]], the trident is only tradeable when either uncharged or fully charged.

The trident of the seas has the same effect in [[drift net fishing]] as the [[merfolk trident]],{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1148163991405043713|date=8 July 2019|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/save/https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1148163991405043713|archivedate=26 August 2019|quote=[Does the trident of the seas have the same effect in driftnet fishing as the merfolk trident?] Yes.}} though it does not have the ability to hold [[pufferfish]] charges (convenient for breathing [[underwater]]).

The staff's charge cannot be used against another player in dangerous PvP, only safe minigames.
